jobs.title: VP, Strategy and Operations
jobs.description:
**Job Description Summary**
===========================


The VP, Strategy and Operations acts as the Chief Procurement Officer's principal partner in developing and executing strategy and driving the transformation agenda: responsible for developing category strategies to optimise value from third\-party spend, building the procurement operating model, and architecting the procurement modernization agenda, focused on technology, AI and process optimisation across source\-to\-pay. The role demands a strategic, analytical and operational mindset in equal measure, deep functional expertise, a data and technology driven approach, and the ability to lead through influence rather than direct line management.


The role would suit an experienced and/or qualified procurement professional, operating at senior level and requiring deep and broad expertise across procurement strategy, technology and operations. Works independently, sets direction for others and mentors junior members of the team. The role carries no direct category accountability of its own, but rather partners with category and business leaders, and is measured through the results of these teams.

  

  

**About the Team**
==================


RELX leverages its spend through a central Global Procurement function responsible for delivering procurement savings, driving supply chain efficiencies, and mitigating supply risk across all major spend categories — technology, cloud and AI, data and content, marketing, professional services, contingent labour, print and production, facilities and travel. Global Procurement is led by the Chief Procurement Officer, supported by Global Category Leaders and a Programme Management Office responsible for procurement policy, process, tools and operational activity across all spend categories.

  

  

**About the Role**
==================


We are looking for an analytically and intellectually driven senior leader, team player and self\-starter with deep operational and strategy expertise across the procurement domain. The role would suit an individual from a technology, finance, consulting or information services background. This role provides significant exposure to and opportunities to influence senior executives across multiple business segments.

  

The role will be based at a primary RELX location in North America, with periodic international travel to our global offices, and reports to the RELX Chief Procurement Officer.

  

  

**Main Accountabilities**
=========================


* Own the development and refresh of the Global Procurement multi\-year strategy, aligned to RELX Group strategy and to each business area's plan.


* Translate strategy into a sequenced transformation roadmap with clear owners, milestones and benefit cases; run the governance that keeps it on track.


* Own end\-to\-end source\-to\-contract process design and performance, and the technology roadmap.


* Drive process simplification, automation and self\-service so that policy\-compliant buying is the path of least resistance for the business.


* Design and evolve the procurement operating model — organisation shape, category architecture, centre\-led versus embedded resourcing, location strategy and the interfaces with other business areas.


* Partner closely with the PMO to ensure improvement initiatives are executed in alignment with strategy.


* Lead and oversee strategic initiatives that cut across categories: supplier consolidation programmes, third\-party cost transformation, procurement integration in M\&A, and make\-versus\-buy reviews.


* Oversee data management and data quality.


* Coach and develop a geographically distributed team of specialists and people managers.


* Build senior relationships across business areas and corporate functions.

  

  

**Requirements**
================


* Have substantial senior experience in procurement, sourcing or third\-party cost management within a large, complex, multinational organisation, including time in a strategy, operations or transformation role.


* Have category expertise across technology and indirect procurement.


* Have a proven track record of designing and delivering procurement or functional transformation at scale — operating model change, technology deployment, or process re\-engineering.


* Have deep working knowledge of the source\-to\-pay lifecycle and at least one major S2P platform, including implementation or major upgrade experience.


* Be strong in commercial and financial fluency — able to build a business case, define and defend savings methodology, and hold a credible conversation with a CFO or divisional finance director.


* Be able to influence and earn credibility with executive stakeholders in a federated, multi\-business\-unit environment where authority is earned rather than granted.


* Have experience leading distributed teams, including managing managers, and building capability.


* Be an exceptional analytical thinker, comfortable with spend data, taxonomies and analytics tooling.


* Be a confident communicator, able to create clear, decision\-oriented materials for senior leadership, including Board\-level presentations.

  

This job is eligible for an annual incentive bonus.This posting is for an existing vacancy.

jobs.title: Senior Director, ALM Research & Analytics
jobs.description:
**Job Description**

**What is the opportunity?**


Lead RBC Corporate Treasury's quantitative ALM methodology development, modelling, research and analytics, focusing on interest rate risk measurement and management. Lead development of behavioral and market risk models, supporting pricing and risk measurement for non\-trading on\-balance sheet products, mortgage and loan commitments, securitization, and term funding. Interest rate risk represents the bank’s largest structural book market risk, with effective measurement and management critical for shareholder value preservation. The team you’ll lead also supports RBC’s Pension Investment Group modeling and measurement, across a diverse set of asset classes, strategies, and ALM topics.

 **What will you do?**

* Lead research, methodology and model development relating to structural interest rate risk, consumer behaviour econometric modeling and forecasting (e.g., prepayment, redemption, pull through, product flows, term / mix preferences), economic capital models, balance sheet dynamics, and retail product and embedded option pricing models, in RBC’s domestic and international banking book balance sheets
* Lead development of diffusion, historic simulation, factor models, and deposit rate models in support of pricing, valuation, and risk measurement including economic capital, economic value and net interest income risk
* Lead and / or collaborate in development and implementation of tools and disciplines to monitor, analyze and identify ALM risks, as required
* Collaborate in development of hedging programs for retail banking product initiatives and campaigns, including mortgage, funding and securitization initiatives
* Liaise with regulatory bodies to explain ALM models and parameters, and their performance, as required
* Support pension investment, ALM, and risk measurement processes via development of requisite models, tools and analytics
* Lead CT's model validation process with GRM, including collaborating with GRM to ensure effective model risk controls and governance, and managing IRRM team's model inventory and behavioural assumption assessment and monitoring schedule
* Collaborate with Finance and Treasury partners to ensure alignment of ALM risk measurement, FTP, and financial performance management systems, as required
* Explore and develop new techniques and approaches, including use of AI in ALM and model development
* Lead and develop a team of high performing ALM modelling experts, providing ongoing staff direction, goal setting, and coaching

 **What do you need to succeed?**

**Must\-have:**

* Graduate degree in a quantitative field such as financial engineering, mathematics, engineering, or economics
* 10\+ years related experience with a strong grasp of ALM practices
* Understanding of banking book balance sheet dynamics, product characteristics, client behaviour, and balance sheet flows, with focus on retail \& commercial banking products
* Solid understanding of financial principles and risk concepts, including financial modelling and engineering, pricing models, econometrics, and fixed income mathematics
* Strong team management and coordination skills, ensuring accountability while fostering a positive, collaborative, and high\-performing environment
* Strong communication and negotiation skills
* Well\-organized and detail oriented, with ability to tailor analysis to required precision (i.e. 80/20 solutions) or attend to details, as needed
* Strong understanding of applicable regulatory guidelines and accounting principles, and related systems

 **Nice\-to\-have:**

* CFA and / or FRM designations, or equivalent
* Strong data and database skills, including SQL
* Prior exposure to ALM risk engine platforms and software (e.g. QRM or similar)

 **What's in it for you?**


We thrive on the challenge to be our best, progressive thinking to keep growing, and working together to deliver trusted advice to help our clients thrive and communities prosper. We care about each other, reaching our potential, making a difference to our communities, and achieving success that is mutual.

* A comprehensive Total Rewards Program including bonuses and flexible benefits
* Leaders who support your development through coaching and managing opportunities
* Ability to make a difference and lasting impact
* Work in an agile, collaborative, progressive, and high\-performing team
* The opportunity to interface with senior level executives from many different parts of the organization

jobs.description:
Global Wealth \& Asset Management is a key growth segment for Manulife, operating across Retail, Wealth, Retirement and Institutional channels in North America, Asia and Europe. The Director, Retirement Strategy will help shape the growth and transformation agenda for the U.S. and Canada Retirement businesses, translating strategic objectives into actionable priorities and quality execution. By strengthening connectivity between Retirement, Wealth and broader Manulife capabilities, this role will support our mission to make decisions easier and lives better for our customers. * Shape and advance the strategic agenda for the U.S. and Canada Retirement businesses by identifying growth opportunities, strategic risks and value\-creation initiatives.
* Develop strategies that strengthen the Retirement businesses and deepen connectivity with Wealth and broader Manulife capabilities.
* Translate strategic objectives into clear priorities, align discretionary spending with those priorities and support business readiness for execution.
* Partner across GWAM, Finance, Transformation and Business Operations to drive cross\-functional collaboration, monitor delivery and recommend interventions or pivots where required.

* Proven ability to manage multiple priorities, exercise sound judgment and deliver results in a dynamic environment.
Superior written and verbal communication skills, including experience preparing materials for senior executive audiences.

**Preferred Qualifications**

jobs.title: Director, Insights, Innovation & R&D (18-month contract)
jobs.description:
The Director, Insights, Innovation, \& R\&D leads the consumer insight, menu innovation, product development, and food quality agenda for KFC Canada. This role turns consumer and business insight into a growth\-driving innovation pipeline, modernizes KFC's core products, and leads the FIT (Food Innovation \& Technology aka Product Development) team from concept through commercialization. The Director partners closely with Marketing, Operations, Supply Chain and franchisees to ensure products are distinctive, consumer\-led, operationally executable and delivered to KFC quality and food safety standards. If you are a leader who thrives in a fast\-paced environment, can navigate ambiguity with action, has ambition to deliver impact and a spirit of what is possible – KFC is an environment that will empower and support your success.

  

  

* Own the integrated consumer insights, menu strategy and innovation agenda, translating consumer, category and cultural insight into clear growth opportunities and the short\-, medium\- and long\-term pipeline and business.
* Lead the FIT team and end\-to\-end product development process, from culinary/product brief and prototyping through consumer validation, restaurant testing, commercialization and launch.
* Modernize and continuously improve KFC Canada's core food portfolio, protecting what consumers love while improving taste, quality, consistency, value and relevance.
* Build and deliver a differentiated innovation pipeline that supports the Marketing growth calendar, creates newsworthy reasons to choose KFC and strengthens the brand across priority occasions and consumer groups.
* Act as guardian of KFC Canada's food philosophy and architect of the menu vision, defining the principles, product standards and strategic choices that guide product development and renovation.
* Lead consumer insights across internal resources and agency partners, ensuring customer understanding is embedded in brand strategy, calendar development, innovation, value and broader business planning.
* Set clear innovation learning agendas and stage gates; use consumer, operational and commercial evidence to make fast decisions on what to advance, optimize or stop.
* Partner with Brand, Retail Marketing, Operations, Supply Chain, Finance and franchisees to ensure innovation is commercially compelling, operationally executable, scalable and supported by strong launch plans.
* Own R\&D prioritization, resources and ways of working, ensuring the team balances core product improvement, calendar innovation, longer\-term pipeline development and rapid test\-and\-learn opportunities.
* Provide leadership oversight of Quality Assurance within the team remit, ensuring robust product and supplier standards, food safety and quality systems, issue escalation, and continuous improvement in partnership with Operations and Supply Chain.
* Deliver credible thought leadership and compelling recommendations to KFC Canada LT, franchisees and cross\-functional stakeholders, aligning the system behind bold but evidence\-based growth choices.
* Build a high\-performing, connected Insights, Innovation, R\&D and QA capability with clear accountability, strong talent development and effective collaboration across the broader business.
  

  

**Education/Certifications**


* Required: Post\-secondary degree in business, marketing, or related discipline
* Preferred: MBA

**Experience**


* 10\+ years of progressive experience across consumer insights, innovation, product development/R\&D, brand, food science or related commercial functions
* Demonstrated experience leading teams and an end\-to\-end food innovation pipeline from insight and concept through product development, testing, commercialization and launch
* Style that inspires and unites cross\-functional teams, bringing clarity in strategy and empowering whilst holding accountable with a spirit of taking people with you.
* Compelling communications capability, translating complex ideas simply to bring clarity and alignment across a diverse set of stakeholders.
* Strong track record of translating consumer insight into commercial growth strategies and high\-impact innovation.
* Strong understanding of operations, supply chain and commercialization requirements; able to balance consumer desirability, operational feasibility and commercial viability.
* Proven ability to modernize core products while building a forward\-looking innovation pipeline.
* Ability to influence senior leaders, franchisees, and complex matrixed stakeholders through ambiguity and transformation.
* Ability to effectively develop and lead high\-performing technical and commercial talent.
* Ability to balance enterprise\-level strategic thinking with curiosity, creativity, pace, and hands\-on problem solving.
* A passion for food, consumers, and emerging trends

**We’d prefer this role to have…**


* Prior experience in QSR, food manufacturing/FMCG, or food retail

**What makes KFC a great place to work?**
**Our People.** We invest in people capability above all else, with a proven track record of developing internal talent to leadership levels across the business both in Canada and globally. We hire and develop people who lead with Smart, Heart and Courage to make a big impact on the business today and grow into leaders of the future.  

**Our Culture.** We are known for a culture that rewards and recognizes bold results and promises everyone a seat at our table. We focus on your personal development as much as your professional development to ensure you can bring your best self to work.

jobs.description:
The **Director, Finance** provides leadership and oversight of key accounting, financial reporting, and controllership activities for Dollar Tree's Canadian operations, ensuring the accuracy and integrity of financial results.


This leader will oversee critical components of the monthly, quarterly, and annual close processes, strengthen financial controls, and ensure compliance with U.S. GAAP, Canadian statutory requirements, company policies, and SOX requirements.  



  

The Director will also partner closely with Finance and business leaders in Canada and the U.S. to support budgeting and forecasting, improve financial processes, and provide insights that enable sound business decisions.  



  

This is a highly visible leadership role requiring strong technical accounting expertise, financial acumen, cross\-functional partnership, and the ability to develop high\-performing teams in a complex, fast\-paced organization.  



  

**What You'll Do**
------------------

### **Financial Accounting \& Controllership**

* Provide leadership and oversight for accounting and controllership activities, ensuring the accuracy, completeness, and integrity of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial results.
* Lead key components of the monthly, quarterly, and annual financial close processes, ensuring timely and accurate reporting in accordance with U.S. GAAP and company policies.
* Partner closely with cross\-functional teams in Canada and Finance and Accounting teams in the U.S. to ensure alignment and consistency in financial reporting and accounting practices.
* Ensure compliance with applicable Canadian statutory requirements related to tax, accounting, and financial reporting.
* Review financial results, account reconciliations, journal entries, and supporting schedules to identify trends, variances, risks, and potential accounting issues.
* Ensure accounting transactions are properly recorded, classified, documented, and supported in accordance with established policies and accounting standards.
* Provide technical accounting guidance and determine appropriate accounting treatment for complex or non\-routine transactions.
* Maintain a strong internal control environment and ensure financial processes and documentation support compliance with SOX requirements.
* Partner with internal and external auditors, providing appropriate documentation and ensuring timely resolution of audit requests and findings.

### **Financial Reporting \& Analysis**

* Oversee the preparation and review of financial statements, management reporting, and supporting financial schedules.
* Analyze financial performance and significant account fluctuations, providing senior leadership with clear explanations of results, trends, risks, and opportunities.
* Partner with FP\&A and business leaders to ensure alignment between accounting results, forecasts, budgets, and overall business performance.
* Support the preparation of annual budgets and updates to monthly financial forecasts.
* Develop reporting and financial insights that improve visibility into business performance and support informed decision\-making.
* Identify potential financial risks and proactively partner with leaders to develop appropriate solutions and corrective actions.

### **Process Improvement \& Financial Controls**

* Lead continuous improvement and automation initiatives that simplify financial processes, reduce manual activities, increase efficiency, and strengthen the overall control environment.
* Establish and maintain accounting policies, procedures, controls, and documentation to promote consistency and compliance across the organization.
* Partner with Finance, IT, and other cross\-functional teams on system implementations, enhancements, integrations, and broader transformation initiatives.
* Ensure effective financial controls are incorporated into new processes, systems, and business initiatives.
* Identify opportunities to improve the scalability, accuracy, and efficiency of accounting and financial reporting processes.

### **Leadership \& Business Partnership**

* Lead, coach, and develop a high\-performing Finance team, establishing clear expectations and creating opportunities for continued professional growth.
* Serve as a trusted financial advisor to senior leaders and cross\-functional partners, providing guidance on accounting, financial controls, and business decisions.
* Build strong partnerships across Accounting, FP\&A, Treasury, Tax, Internal Audit, Operations, IT, and other business functions in Canada and the U.S.
* Translate complex financial and accounting matters into clear, actionable insights for both financial and non\-financial stakeholders.
Champion a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.  
* 

  

**What You'll Bring**
---------------------

### **Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
* 10\+ years of progressive accounting and/or finance experience, including significant experience in controllership, financial accounting, or financial reporting.
* 5\+ years of leadership experience with demonstrated success leading, coaching, and developing accounting or finance professionals.
* Strong knowledge of U.S. GAAP, financial reporting, accounting principles, and internal controls.

* Demonstrated ability to lead through change, solve complex problems, and manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.

jobs.title: Director, Digital Experience Platforms
jobs.description:
Embark on a rewarding career with Sobeys Inc., celebrated among Canada’s Top 100 employers where your unique contributions drive success.
  
  

Role Summary
  
The Director, Digital Experience Platforms (DXP) is accountable for the strategy, engineering delivery, operations, reliability, and evolution of all customer\-facing digital experience platforms across Empire banners. This role leads the technology execution of web, mobile, content, search, UX platform capabilities, and front\-end engineering ecosystems, ensuring seamless, scalable, secure, and high\-performing customer experiences.
  
  

The Director serves as the primary technology counterpart to Digital Experience, Digital Product, Customer Engagement, Commerce, and Banner teams, translating business vision into enterprise\-grade digital capabilities. The role is responsible for balancing innovation, delivery velocity, operational excellence, and platform sustainability while enabling a product\-led operating model.
  
  

Accountabilities \& Responsibilities
  
  

Digital Experience Platform Leadership
  
* Own the end\-to\-end technology strategy, roadmap, delivery, and operation of all digital experience platforms across web, mobile, and customer\-facing digital channels.
* Define the future\-state architecture and capability evolution roadmap for DXP technologies including Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), front\-end platforms, mobile applications, search technologies, design systems, and supporting digital services.
* Ensure platform capabilities support enterprise digital commerce objectives, customer experience strategies, and banner\-specific priorities.
* Establish technology standards, engineering practices, and governance frameworks for front\-end and customer experience platforms.


Engineering Delivery \& Execution
  
* Lead multiple engineering teams responsible for:
* Customer websites
* Mobile applications
* Front\-end engineering
* Search and discovery platforms
* Design systems
* Content delivery platforms
* AEM ecosystem
* Drive delivery of strategic initiatives through Agile product teams.
* Ensure predictable execution, release readiness, and high\-quality software delivery.
* Partner with Product and Business teams to define roadmaps, priorities, and release strategies.
* Govern delivery performance, release quality, technical debt management, and modernization initiatives.


Digital Experience Reliability \& Operations
  
* Own availability, performance, scalability, and resilience of all digital experience platforms.
* Establish operational excellence standards for:
* Incident management
* Production support
* Monitoring and observability
* Disaster recovery
* Capacity planning
* Lead major incident response and continuous service improvement initiatives.
* Ensure regulatory, privacy, accessibility, and security compliance requirements are embedded within platform delivery.


UX Technology \& Experience Enablement
  
* Own the technology ecosystem that enables experience delivery, including:
* Design systems
* Component libraries
* Content management capabilities
* Front\-end frameworks
* Partner with UX and CX teams to ensure customer experience strategies are translated into scalable technology solutions.
* Build strong alignment between design intent and engineering execution.
* Enable consistency across banners while balancing local business needs.


Platform Modernization \& Innovation
  
* Champion modern engineering practices including:
* Headless architecture
* API\-first development
* Component\-driven development
* DevOps and CI/CD
* Cloud\-native architecture
* Evaluate emerging technologies and industry trends to continuously improve customer experiences.
* Drive platform simplification and technology rationalization to reduce complexity and improve speed\-to\-market.


Leadership Responsibilities
  
* Lead, coach, and develop a high\-performing team of managers, architects, Analysts and Developers.
* Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, customer obsession, and operational excellence.
* Build succession plans and talent development strategies for key digital capabilities.
* Establish clear ownership and measurable outcomes across engineering and platform teams.
* Create an environment focused on collaboration, continuous improvement, and execution excellence.


Qualifications
  
  

Education
  
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or related discipline.

Reporting to the Deputy Chief Financial Officer, the Director of Finance provides enterprise\-wide leadership and oversight of the Hospital’s financial operations, planning, reporting and internal control environment.  

Connecting financial strategy with operational decision\-making, the Director helps guide the organization through evolving funding models, financial pressures and growth opportunities. The Director is responsible for advancing financial strategy, strengthening fiscal stewardship, optimizing funding opportunities and ensuring regulatory compliance, while fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement.  

As a key finance leader, the Director partners closely with clinical and operational leaders to align financial planning with organizational priorities. The role extends beyond traditional financial oversight: the Director serves as a trusted advisor and business partner who supports critical decision\-making, identifies opportunities for innovation and efficiency, and helps ensure Michael Garron Hospital (MGH), a division of Toronto East Health Network (TEHN), remains well positioned to deliver on its strategic priorities in an increasingly complex healthcare environment.

jobs.title: Director, Sales Strategy and Resident Experience
jobs.description:

As the Director, Sales Strategy \& Resident Experience, you will contribute to Extendicare's purpose of *Helping People Live Better* by leading the regional sales function across a portfolio of retirement residences. Reporting to the Regional Director of Operations, you will provide direct leadership to residence\-based sales professionals and work closely with Operations, Finance, and Marketing to maximize portfolio performance. This role is accountable for developing and executing Key Performance Indicators that achieve occupancy, rate, revenue, and NOI objectives. Through your strategic thinking, operational execution, and coaching, you will build a culture of accountability and results while ensuring an exceptional experience for prospects, residents, and families.

* Lead and develop a high\-performing, accountable sales team that demonstrate Extendicare's Values and deliver results, including exceptional customer experience, and continuous quality improvement.
* Ensure consistent, exceptional customer experience throughout the sales journey, including seamless transitions from prospect to resident.

**Key Responsibilities:**

.

For more than 130 years, The Salvation Army has served people in need in communities across Canada and Bermuda. Building on our roots as a world\-wide Christian church, each year we help more than 2 million people, providing necessities such as food, clothing and shelter. In addition, we support people experiencing unemployment, addiction and family challenges. We continually adapt and innovate to meet emerging needs and live out our mission, vision and values of hope, service, dignity and stewardship. As a faith\- and values\-based organization, we hire and serve people of all backgrounds and walks of life \- there is a place for everyone to belong here.

The Salvation Army exists to share the love of Jesus Christ, meet human needs and be a transforming influence in the communities of our world.

Lead the development, monitoring, and forecasting of annual budgets for large Ministry Units (MUs) and territorial departments, ensuring alignment with organizational priorities and budgeting guidelines.  

*

Support donor\-funded initiatives through financial analysis, funding oversight, trend identification, stakeholder presentations, and participation in special projects and departmental activities.  
* 

  

**Education and Experience Qualifications:**

The Salvation Army will provide reasonable accommodation upon request. Please email **Recruitment.Accommodations@salvationarmy.ca** if you have a need for any accommodation and we will be pleased to discuss this with you.

jobs.title: Director, Data Science
jobs.description:
161 Bay Street (93021\), Canada, Toronto,Toronto, Ontario,Director, Data Science### **About Capital One Canada**


For 30 years, we’ve been on a mission to change banking for good. We challenge the traditional bank stereotype, fostering a culture where innovation thrives and bold ideas are celebrated.

  

We’re driven by what’s possible, leveraging the power of data and technology to empower innovative solutions, inspire one another to dream boldly, and take transformative ownership of decisions and outcomes that directly impact millions of Canadians. Every challenge is an opportunity to lead from the front, working together toward a shared vision that extends far beyond banking.

  

We balance high\-performance with investment in your long\-term success, ensuring you have the support you need to do your best work. Here, you’ll take full accountability for your path, upskilling through hands\-on experience and mentorship, to turn your curiosity into a career built on your own terms.

  

Are you ready to redefine what’s next?

### **About the Team**


Data is at the center of everything we do. As a startup, we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast\-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data\-driven decision\-making.

  

We're building a portfolio of agentic AI products to transform Capital One's engineering organizations and lines of business – autonomous coding agents, context engineering, and agentic model\-development lifecycle to name a few. We're creating a new science team to help define the long\-term strategy, analyze \& optimize impact throughout the ecosystem, and drive business value at enterprise scale. As a scientist on the team, you'd design AI/ML models and help build the solutions behind these products. You'd also own the science that guides them: designing experiments (A/B tests), modeling telemetry, and turning the results into AI strategy and guidance for C\-suite leadership.

### **About the Role**


As a Data Scientist at Capital One, you’ll be part of a team that’s leading the next wave of disruption at a whole new scale, using the latest in AI and machine learning technologies and operating across billions of customer records to unlock the big opportunities that help everyday people save money, time and agony in their financial lives.

  

In this role, you will:

* Partner with a cross\-functional team of data scientists, AI \& ML engineers, and product managers to deliver enterprise products customers love
* Leverage a broad stack of technologies — Python, Conda, AWS, H2O, Spark, and more — to reveal the insights hidden within huge volumes of numeric and textual data
* Build machine learning models through all phases of development, from design through training, evaluation, validation, and implementation
* Flex your interpersonal skills to translate the complexity of your work into tangible business goals

  

The ideal candidate is:

* Customer first. You love the process of analyzing and creating, but also share our passion to do the right thing. You know at the end of the day it’s about making the right decision for our customers.
* Innovative. You continually research and evaluate emerging technologies. You stay current on published state\-of\-the\-art methods, technologies, and applications and seek out opportunities to apply them.
* Creative. You thrive on bringing definition to big, undefined problems. You love asking questions and pushing hard to find answers. You’re not afraid to share a new idea.
* A leader. You challenge conventional thinking and work with stakeholders to identify and improve the status quo. You’re passionate about talent development for your own team and beyond.
* Technical. You’re comfortable with open\-source languages and are passionate about developing further. You have hands\-on experience developing data science solutions using open\-source tools and cloud computing platforms.
* Statistically\-minded. You’ve built models, validated them, and backtested them. You know how to interpret a confusion matrix or a ROC curve. You have experience with clustering, classification, sentiment analysis, time series, and deep learning.
* A data guru. “Big data” doesn’t faze you. You have the skills to retrieve, combine, and analyze data from a variety of sources and structures. You know understanding the data is often the key to great data science.

### **Basic Qualifications:**

* Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining one of the following with an expectation that the required degree will be obtained on or before the scheduled start date :
	+ A Bachelor's Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) plus 9 years of experience performing data analytics
	+ A Master's Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) or an MBA with a quantitative concentration plus 7 years of experience performing data analytics
	+ A PHD in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) plus 4 years of experience performing data analytics
* At least 4 years of experience leveraging open source programming languages for large scale data analysis
* At least 4 years of experience building/deploying AI/ML models in production
* At least 4 years of experience designing and analyzing A/B tests

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* PhD in “STEM” field (Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics) plus 5 years of experience in data analytics
* 3\+ years of experience working with AWS
* 5\+ years of experience

The Director, Insights, Innovation, \& R\&D leads the consumer insight, menu innovation, product development, and food quality agenda for KFC Canada. The Director partners closely with Marketing, Operations, Supply Chain and franchisees to ensure products are distinctive, consumer\-led, operationally executable and delivered to KFC quality and food safety standards. If you are a leader who thrives in a fast\-paced environment, can navigate ambiguity with action, has ambition to deliver impact and a spirit of what is possible – KFC is an environment that will empower and support your success.

  

  

* Own the integrated consumer insights, menu strategy and innovation agenda, translating consumer, category and cultural insight into clear growth opportunities and the short\-, medium\- and long\-term pipeline and business.
* Lead the FIT team and end\-to\-end product development process, from culinary/product brief and prototyping through consumer validation, restaurant testing, commercialization and launch.
* Modernize and continuously improve KFC Canada's core food portfolio, protecting what consumers love while improving taste, quality, consistency, value and relevance.

* Act as guardian of KFC Canada's food philosophy and architect of the menu vision, defining the principles, product standards and strategic choices that guide product development and renovation.
* Lead consumer insights across internal resources and agency partners, ensuring customer understanding is embedded in brand strategy, calendar development, innovation, value and broader business planning.
* Set clear innovation learning agendas and stage gates; use consumer, operational and commercial evidence to make fast decisions on what to advance, optimize or stop.
* Partner with Brand, Retail Marketing, Operations, Supply Chain, Finance and franchisees to ensure innovation is commercially compelling, operationally executable, scalable and supported by strong launch plans.
* Own R\&D prioritization, resources and ways of working, ensuring the team balances core product improvement, calendar innovation, longer\-term pipeline development and rapid test\-and\-learn opportunities.
* Provide leadership oversight of Quality Assurance within the team remit, ensuring robust product and supplier standards, food safety and quality systems, issue escalation, and continuous improvement in partnership with Operations and Supply Chain.
* Deliver credible thought leadership and compelling recommendations to KFC Canada LT, franchisees and cross\-functional stakeholders, aligning the system behind bold but evidence\-based growth choices.
* Build a high\-performing, connected Insights, Innovation, R\&D and QA capability with clear accountability, strong talent development and effective collaboration across the broader business.
  

  

**Education/Certifications**


* Required: Post\-secondary degree in business, marketing, or related discipline
* Preferred: MBA

**Experience**


* 10\+ years of progressive experience across consumer insights, innovation, product development/R\&D, brand, food science or related commercial functions
* Demonstrated experience leading teams and an end\-to\-end food innovation pipeline from insight and concept through product development, testing, commercialization and launch
* Style that inspires and unites cross\-functional teams, bringing clarity in strategy and empowering whilst holding accountable with a spirit of taking people with you.
* Compelling communications capability, translating complex ideas simply to bring clarity and alignment across a diverse set of stakeholders.
* Strong track record of translating consumer insight into commercial growth strategies and high\-impact innovation.
* Strong understanding of operations, supply chain and commercialization requirements; able to balance consumer desirability, operational feasibility and commercial viability.
* Proven ability to modernize core products while building a forward\-looking innovation pipeline.
* Ability to influence senior leaders, franchisees, and complex matrixed stakeholders through ambiguity and transformation.
* Ability to effectively develop and lead high\-performing technical and commercial talent.
* Ability to balance enterprise\-level strategic thinking with curiosity, creativity, pace, and hands\-on problem solving.
* A passion for food, consumers, and emerging trends

**We’d prefer this role to have…**


* Prior experience in QSR, food manufacturing/FMCG, or food retail

**What makes KFC a great place to work?**
**Our People.** We invest in people capability above all else, with a proven track record of developing internal talent to leadership levels across the business both in Canada and globally. We hire and develop people who lead with Smart, Heart and Courage to make a big impact on the business today and grow into leaders of the future.  

**Our Culture.** We are known for a culture that rewards and recognizes bold results and promises everyone a seat at our table. We focus on your personal development as much as your professional development to ensure you can bring your best self to work.  

**Why you’ll love working here**
